nodes.label: Memphis · Der Dümmste fliegt (Entwurf)
nodes.rationale: 1280x720 static mockup: question header 'Frage 14', 3x2 grid of player cards with three life dots each, eliminated player (Emil) faded and struck by a zigzag, round badges 1/2 for vote counts.

nodes.label: Memphis design direction (P)
nodes.rationale: 80s Memphis look: fonts Lilita One + Rubik, lavender #F4F1FF background with black dot grid, ink #141414, accents pink #FF6FA8, teal #1FB5A8, yellow #FFD23F, violet #7B5CFF; team colours Rot #E8453C, Blau #3B82F6, Grün #22C55E. Every screen mixes shapes (circles, arches, triangles) and slight rotations for a playful party feel. Two authoring variants visible: P-Handy/P-Leinwand/P-TP/P-WWDS use squiggle curves and Rubik root font with letter-spacing .5px, the others use zigzag polylines.

nodes.label: Hard offset shadows with thick black outlines
nodes.rationale: box-shadow N px N px 0 (no blur) in ink or accent colour plus 3-6px #141414 borders; pure CSS, so it survives DOM mirroring to the audience window.

nodes.label: Zigzag and squiggle SVG ornaments
nodes.rationale: Inline SVG polylines/quadratic curves with 7px stroke used as decoration and, in DDF, as a strike-through for the eliminated player.
